summary: Follow-up verification of iteration_2 fixes. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests pass (auth+cookie, org/project/sprint/task/time-entry/timer POSTs all return 200 with no _id, PATCH/DELETE, access control 401/403, 422 validation, analytics, seed data). Validate project_id/sprint_id belong to org in POST/PATCH /tasks (low)
